items.title: Nvidia, Meta, Revolution Medicines, Abercrombie, Intuit, Salesforce, Moderna, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: Stocks traded modestly lower Wednesday ahead of Nvidia’s earnings report and after the personal consumption expenditures index, or PCE, for July revealed inflation was a bit stronger than expected.  Intel  rose o.9% and  Broadcom  declined 0.3% with investors in wait-and-see mode when it comes to chip stocks.  Nvidia  reported earnings after the bell, and shares rose about 4%.

items.summary: JPMorgan downgraded Intuit stock due to disappointing full-year guidance. The firm also trimmed its price target on INTU shares rather aggressively to $331.

items.title: Intuit (INTU) Stock Trades Down, Here Is Why
items.summary: Shares of financial technology platform Intuit (NASDAQ:INTU) fell 3.2% in the afternoon session after the company issued weaker-than-expected near-term and 2027 revenue guidance while projecting slowing growth across key consumer segments, overshadowing its second-quarter earnings beat.
